entities.summary: Marián Geišberg was a Slovak actor. Geišberg was recognised in 2001 for his stage acting in the Jozef Kroner Awards. Geišberg won the Best Supporting Actor award at the Sun in a Net Awards in 2019 for his role in Čertí brko. His son is Slovak actor Marek Geišberg.
